title: Fourier degree criterion
statement: For a function $f$ on the Boolean cube $\\{-1,1\\}^n$ and an integer $k\\ge 0$, its Fourier degree is at most $k$ if and only if every Fourier coefficient indexed by a subset $S\\subseteq[n]$ with $|S|>k$ is zero.
hypotheses_covered: A function from the Boolean cube on n coordinates to the reals
